hints.title: Choosing Extrema Multipliers
hints.text: To maximize (a * b) - (c * d), choose the two largest numbers for a and b, and the two smallest numbers for c and d.

hints.title: Sorting or Single-Pass Min/Max
hints.text: either sort the array or maintain the top two maximums and bottom two minimums in a single pass.

hints.title: Evaluating Product Difference
hints.text: compute (max1 * max2) - (min1 * min2) and return the difference.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting isolates two largest and two smallest elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^4) index quadruplets takes prohibitive time on large arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting takes O(N log N) time with O(1) space, while single-pass linear scanning achieves O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that extreme values (two largest and two smallest) guarantee maximal product difference.
